claims.statement: pytest.ini configures the suite with testpaths=tests, pythonpath=src (so `import src.*` resolves without an install step), and addopts=-ra --strict-markers (which reports all non-passing outcomes and errors on unregistered markers).

The development dependency is pytest>=8.0 (requirements-dev.txt); the runtime deps in requirements.txt (streamlit, langchain, langchain-openai, openai, edge-tts, python-dotenv, qrcode[pil]) must also be installed because the tests import the modules under test.

The GitHub Actions test workflow (.github/workflows/test.yml) runs the suite on push to main and on PR against main, on ubuntu-latest with Python 3.10, installing both requirements.txt and requirements-dev.txt (with --only-binary=:all:) and running pytest.

conftest.py provides an autouse _required_llm_env fixture that sets SKIP_CONFIG_VALIDATION=1 and fills in the five required LLM env vars with test values only when unset, plus shared sample_questions and tmp_json_file fixtures (a factory writing JSON to a tmp_path file).

test_app.py stubs the streamlit module and all src.* submodules (qrcode_service, avatar, content_filter, llm_service, quiz_data, tts_service) by replacing them in sys.modules via monkeypatch.setitem, then reloads app so the stubs take effect, and runs main() with a hand-rolled _Streamlit fake whose session_state holds a single id=7 question and query_params {"q": "7"}.

test_app.py captures the QR share URLs by monkeypatching app.generate_qr_code with a spy that appends each URL and returns a BytesIO; it asserts main() builds https://lappquiz.ict.unesp.br?q=7 when APP_URL is unset (the config default) and https://quiz.example.com?q=7 when APP_URL is set.

The test_app stubs short-circuit check_text, evaluate_answer, generate_speech, and the avatar GIF calls, so the two test_app tests validate only QR-link construction and do not exercise the real moderation, LLM, TTS, or avatar behavior (those are covered by the dedicated module tests).

test_content_filter.py exercises the real BLOCKED_KEYWORDS and BLOCKED_PATTERNS: it pins keyword blocking across the four PT/EN sexual/violent categories, leet normalization (4→3, 3→8, FODA→foda), pattern blocking, the keyword-then-pattern ordering in check_text_local, and the get_warning_level 0→none/1→first/2→second/3→blocked escalation ladder.

test_content_filter.py pins the LLM-moderation contract: a 'BLOQUEAR' response blocks, the LLM is not called when the local check already blocked, the LLM is called once with the real get_litellm_llm for clean text, an LLM exception fails open returning (False, None), and use_llm=False never invokes the LLM.

test_llm_service.py mocks ChatOpenAI at the get_litellm_llm/get_openrouter_fallback_llm boundary (a fixture reloads src.llm_service with test env vars) and pins build_prompt (contains all three inputs; blank user answer becomes '(sem resposta)'), clean_text_for_tts (strips markdown, reduces links to labels, collapses newlines), and the three evaluate_answer outcomes: primary succeeds (fallback not called), primary fails → fallback succeeds, both fail → RuntimeError whose message contains 'ambos os provedores falharam' plus both error strings.

test_qrcode_service.py asserts generate_qr_code returns an io.BytesIO whose first 8 bytes are the PNG signature, exercising the real qrcode library; test_quiz_data.py covers load_questions (valid JSON + JSONDecodeError on invalid), get_question (valid/negative/out-of-range), and get_question_by_id (existing/missing) using the sample_questions and tmp_json_file fixtures.

Known test gaps: there are no integration tests for tts_service.generate_speech (needs the edge-tts network API), the avatar GIF generation pipeline (PIL drawing + on-disk cache), or a full Streamlit render; test_app's stubs bypass the real moderation/LLM/TTS/avatar collaborators, so it exercises only QR-link construction.
test_config.py mirrors the test_app approach at the config level, reloading src.config under env overrides to assert APP_URL defaults to https://lappquiz.ict.unesp.br and honors an APP_URL override.
